title.es: Aquel del amor de su vida
title.en: The One With the Love of Her Life

description.es: Marta le dice a Damián que no quiere acercarse a Jaime. Damián le responde que es porque está enamorada del fotógrafo. Le dice a Marta que es demasiado fría y que también está tratando con frialdad a su marido, y discuten. Marta va a la tienda, y ella y Fina discuten sobre Jaime. Fina admite que está celosa. Marta le dice a Fina que es el amor de su vida.
description.en: Marta tells Damián that she does not want to grow close to Jaime. Damián replies that it is because she is in love with the photographer. He tells Marta that she is far too cold and that she is freezing her husband out as well, and they argue. Marta goes to the store, and she and Fina argue about Jaime. Fina admits that she is jealous. Marta tells Fina that she is the love of her life.
